$comment: Items: free-text questions whose answer is one number (counts, years, ages, durations, height, weight, doses) are retyped to integer or decimal, with a UCUM unit and generous limits that catch typos. Free-text questions that may hold several values (e.g. twins' birth weights, years of several miscarriages, sleep from–to) or clock times stay free text.

Population (milestone 10): only positive evidence fills an answer; an absence of records never answers 'no'. Codes are checked with npm run verify-codes (fhir/terminology-check.md). Collections: active Conditions, active AllergyIntolerances, active MedicationStatements and MedicationRequests (medicationCodeableConcept only), completed Immunizations, final Observations.

74261e1e-0815-4c2f-9937-2ae06a5d6177.$comment: Long-term illness: any long-term diagnosis (marked permanent, or unmarked on the problem list)

360e50a8-34d1-48bd-870a-97d6a154d22e.$comment: Which, and how treated: the names of the long-term diagnoses

7806e00f-02a1-4e2e-a958-ad8325e99fd8.$comment: Allergies: 'yes' when there is an active allergy; 'no' when the record states no known allergy of any kind (SNOMED CT 716186003 without a category). A statement scoped to one kind, like the IPS's no known medication allergy (716186003 with category medication), says nothing of the others, so it answers nothing here.
